C01.subject: Student research on cleanroom operations
C01.body:
Hi Dana,

My name is Niharika Ahirekar, a student at Rochester Institute of Technology researching cleanroom operations in industry.

Fab management is where cleanroom operations get tested most directly, which is why your role catches my interest. The new Singapore expansion houses a cleanroom of over 23,000 sqm, creating a scale-up challenge for maintaining uniform contamination control across such a large area. Understanding how that scale pressure balances with the need for consistent yield is the tension our research is trying to understand.

Could I ask you for fifteen minutes later this week or next for a short conversation online?

Best,
Niharika Ahirekar
